hypotheses.justification: planeExponentDifference r s is defined as fun i => (s i : ℤ) - (r i : ℤ). New proof: split on whether some s ∈ f.support has s ≠ r. If one does, the existing proof applies unchanged. If none does, every s ∈ f.support equals r. Take v := fun _ => 1, which is nonzero, and k = 0 for every s: since s = r, the difference is fun i => (r i : ℤ) - r i = 0 = 0 • v. So the conclusion holds without hnonsingleton. The other hypotheses are genuinely needed. hnrank is needed because a rank-two support has no common direction. hr is needed: for f = X 0 + X 1 (support {(1,0),(0,1)}) and r = 0, f is not rank two because any three support points include two equal ones, so the determinant is 0. hnonsingleton holds, yet the differences (1,0) and (0,1) are not multiples of one common vector.
